visual_identity.core_identity: A rooted predatory fungus that resembles a large mushroom until several long whip-like tendrils lash from its body.
visual_identity.silhouette: Thick mushroom stalk and cap with multiple long narrow tendrils extending outward in sweeping curves.
visual_identity.body_shape: Rooted fungal stalk with cap and four or more flexible tendrils emerging around the upper stalk.
visual_identity.limb_structure: No walking limbs; only variant-specific whip-like tendrils extend from the rooted fungal body.
visual_identity.surface: Simple cap and stalk with sparse spots; tendrils smooth and uncluttered.
must_keep: clear contrast between cap and tendrils

scene_identity.natural_posture: Rooted firmly to floor or soil while tendrils arc outward.
behavior_style: lashing from a fixed root point

accuracy_checks: tendrils do not turn body into octopus

known_failure_modes.correction: restore mushroom cap/stalk as dominant body and keep tendrils as secondary extensions
